source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The open source packages are compiled in Docker via packages.sh, then the numbered scripts apply the patches and copy packages and binaries into the speaker's rootfs. The Python API api/main.py handles the intents of the installed voice assistant.
